'''Gusha's Luck''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that belonged to [[Gusha]]. It was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In [[137 ABY]], the cantina was visited by [[Cade Skywalker]], [[Jariah Syn]], and [[Gunn Yage]].

Gusha's Luck was known to serve both [[Tatooine Sunburn|Tatooine Sunrises]] and [[Corellian ale/Legends|Corellian ale]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to the glossary in [[Legacy (2006) 38|''Legacy'' (2006) 38]], "gusha" means lucky in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. This would mean that the bartender's name is "Lucky" (a possible reference to rabbits' feet being thought to be lucky) and that his cantina is named "Lucky's Luck."
